description_en: Creates an OpenID Connect (OIDC) identity provider (IdP) to configure a trust relationship between Alibaba Cloud and an external IdP. This topic provides an example on how to create an IdP named TestOIDCProvider to configure a trust relationship between the external IdP Okta and Alibaba Cloud
description_zh: 调用CreateOIDCProvider创建OIDC身份提供商，配置阿里云与外部身份提供商（IdP）的信任关系
kebab_example: aliyun ims create-oidc-provider --oidc-provider-name TestOIDCProvider --issuer-url https://xxxxxx.example.com --description This_is_an_OIDC_Provider. --client-ids 4984697434547170000 --fingerprints 902ef2deeb3c5b13ea4c3d5193629309e2310000 --issuance-limit-time 6 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateOIDCProvider

parameters.help_en:
The name of the OIDC IdP.

The name can contain letters, digits, and special characters and cannot start or end with the special characters. The special characters are `periods, (.), hyphens (-), and underscores (_)`.\`\`

The name can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
OIDC身份提供商的名称。

格式：允许英文字母、数字、特殊字符`.-_`，不能以特殊字符`.-_`开头或结尾。

长度：最大128个字符
parameters.name: oidc_provider_name

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the issuer, which is provided by the external IdP. The URL of the issuer must be unique within an Alibaba Cloud account.

The URL of the issuer must start with `https` and be in the valid URL format. The URL cannot contain query parameters that follow a question mark (`?`) or logon information that is identified by at signs (`@`). The URL cannot be a fragment URL that contains number signs (`#`).

The URL can be up to 255 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
颁发者URL。由外部IdP提供。同一个阿里云账号下必须唯一。

格式：该URL必须以`https`开头，符合标准URL格式，不允许带有query参数（以`?`标识）、fragment片段（以`#`标识）和登录信息（以`@`标识）。

长度：最大255个字符
parameters.name: issuer_url

parameters.help_en:
The description of the OIDC IdP.

The description can be up to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
OIDC身份提供商的描述。

长度：最大256个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the client, which is provided by the external IdP. If you want to specify multiple client IDs, separate the client IDs with commas (,).

The client ID can contain letters, digits, and special characters and cannot start with the special characters. The special characters are `periods (.), hyphens (-), underscores (_), colons (:), and forward slashes (/)`.\`\`

The client ID can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
客户端ID。由外部IdP提供。多个之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。

格式：允许英文字母、数字、特殊字符`.-_:/`，不能以特殊字符`.-_:/`开头。

长度：单个客户端ID最大128个字符
parameters.name: client_ids

parameters.help_en:
The fingerprint of the HTTPS CA certificate, which is provided by the external IdP. If you want to specify multiple fingerprints, separate the fingerprints with commas (,).

The fingerprint can contain letters and digits.

The fingerprint can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
HTTPS CA证书的验证指纹。由外部IdP提供。多个之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。


格式：允许英文字母和数字。

长度：单个验证指纹最大128个字符
parameters.name: fingerprints

parameters.help_en: The earliest time when an external IdP can issue an ID token. If the value of the iat field in the ID token is later than the current time, the request is rejected. Unit: hours. Valid values: 1 to 168
parameters.help_zh:
允许外部IdP颁发ID Token的最早签发时间。ID Token中的iat字段如果距离当前时间大于这个值则请求会被拒绝。
单位：小时。取值范围：1~168
parameters.name: issuance_limit_time

OIDCProvider.description_en: The information about the OIDC IdP

Arn.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the OIDC IdP

CreateDate.description_en: The time when the OIDC IdP was created. The time is displayed in UTC

Description.description_en: The description of the OIDC IdP

Fingerprints.description_en: The fingerprint of the HTTPS certificate

GmtCreate.description_en: The timestamp when the OIDC IdP was created

GmtModified.description_en: The timestamp when the OIDC IdP was modified

IssuanceLimitTime.description_en: The earliest time when an external IdP can issue an ID token. If the value of the iat field in the ID token is later than the current time, the request is rejected. Unit: hours. Valid values: 1 to 168
IssuanceLimitTime.description_zh:
允许外部IdP颁发ID Token的最早签发时间。ID Token中的iat字段如果距离当前时间大于这个值则请求会被拒绝。
单位：小时。取值范围：1~168

OIDCProviderName.description_en: The name of the OIDC IdP

UpdateDate.description_en: The time when the OIDC IdP was modified. The time is displayed in UTC
